ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: SW — Weather Suite
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The generic engine half of WEATHER_SUITE_SLICE_1 — a fixed-geometry "arc from the substellar point" test any tidally-locked Star Wars planet could use unchanged (PlanetGeometryDef + MapComponent_TerminatorBand), a permanent terminator-front storm wall riding vanilla GameCondition_Flashstorm, a nightside-gated dark-side aurora riding vanilla GameCondition_Aurora/ThoughtWorker_Aurora unchanged, and a Tier-1 forecast-instrument ThingComp that reads the map's real weather-commonality table read-only (no RNG, so it can never desync the roll it reports on).
Campaign-specific wiring (Ash'karr's real substellar point and band arcs, folk-sign flavor text) lives in RimUtinni: Weather Suite (`mandrake.rut.weathersuite`). This mod carries no Ash'karr/clan/story references — see `design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md`'s engine/content split.
v1 slice only: terminator storms, dark-side auroras, Tier 0-1 forecasting. Glass storms, static seasons, pressure tides, spore blooms, mirages and Tier 2-4 forecasting are `design/Jawa/proposals/weather_suite_deep_design.md`'s v2/dream ladder, awaiting PROPOSAL_SUITE_REVIEW_1.
